memory: I have shown that at 3.00 N contacts with Rc ≳ 0.30 mm develop an annular rim depression and rim strain concentration that coincide with a 10–20% τ overshoot, though recovery remains single‑exponential. My working hypothesis links rim indentation/strain localization to increased viscoelastic dissipation. I have varied spacer radius and measured profilometry and DIC but have not tested a compliant annular shim. Current position: design a controlled shim experiment that preserves Rc while decoupling the rigid edge to test whether τ returns to the previously observed Rc–linear trend.
openQuestion: Can a radius‑matched silicone annular shim (specified thickness/shore) eliminate rim strain concentration and restore τ to the Rc–linear trend at 3.00 N?
